feed_parser.purpose: Ingest RSS and Atom feeds from agency websites and media-release feeds

yt_dlp.purpose: Capture metadata for public video and embedded media URLs without downloading by default

social_analyzer.purpose: Optional registry discovery probe for candidate public social profiles

newsboat.purpose: Optional human/operator RSS review, not scheduled automation

feediverse.purpose: Reference pattern for RSS-to-Mastodon templates and de-duplication

gofeed.purpose: Alternative if feed ingestion is later moved to Go
